name: Admin Proposal Section Sync (Preview & Apply)
description: Admin uses the SyncPreviewModal on the proposal edit page to preview a server-computed diff between the current section's content_json and the canonical default, then applies the sync to overwrite. Backend endpoints: GET /api/proposals/sections/:id/sync-preview/ and POST /api/proposals/sections/:id/apply-sync/. UI lives at frontend/components/BusinessProposal/admin/SyncPreviewModal.vue (mounted in pages/panel/proposals/[id]/edit.vue).
